title: The Princess and the Lost Star

pages.title: A light in the courtyard
pages.caption: Nora finds a little lantern.
pages.speech: Princess Nora found a star-shaped lantern in the courtyard. It had rolled away from the evening parade. Someone must be looking for you, she said.
pages.art: Princess Nora with warm brown skin long dark braid lavender practical dress and small gold crown finds glowing star paper lantern in courtyard.

pages.title: Ask a friend
pages.caption: Have you seen this star?
pages.speech: Nora asked the gardener. Have you seen this star? The gardener shook her head, then pointed toward the busy village square. Let us ask together.
pages.art: Same princess shows star paper lantern to friendly woman gardener near castle gate, flower beds.

pages.title: Follow the ribbon
pages.caption: A golden ribbon on the path.
pages.speech: A little golden ribbon lay on the path. It matched the lantern's ribbon. Nora followed it carefully, keeping the lantern safe in both hands.
pages.art: Princess carrying star paper lantern follows golden ribbon along cobbled village path.

pages.title: Help along the way
pages.caption: A basket has tipped over.
pages.speech: Beside the bakery, a basket had tipped over. Nora stopped to help gather the wrapped rolls. Thank you, said the baker. Kindness is never a detour.
pages.art: Princess and smiling baker gather wrapped bread rolls from clean paving; star lantern safe on bench.

pages.title: The missing lantern
pages.caption: A small child looks worried.
pages.speech: In the square, a child was searching beside the parade cart. My star is missing, he said. Nora knelt down. Is this the one you made?
pages.art: Princess kneels to show star paper lantern to worried young child beside decorated parade cart.

pages.title: Found at last
pages.caption: The star belongs to the parade.
pages.speech: That is my star! The child smiled. Nora helped tie its ribbon onto the cart. Together they checked that the knot was secure.
pages.art: Child and princess attach glowing star paper lantern to low parade cart with ribbon, smiling villagers.

pages.title: An invitation
pages.caption: Walk with us, Nora!
pages.speech: Walk with us, said the child. Nora joined the parade. There were big lanterns and tiny lanterns, each made by someone in the village.
pages.art: Princess child gardener baker walk together beside small cart, varied glowing paper lanterns at dusk.

pages.title: Everyone brings a little light
pages.caption: Helping made the evening brighter.
pages.speech: The lanterns glowed as evening fell. Nora had not found a real star from the sky. She had found a chance to help, and new friends to share the light.
pages.art: Wide welcoming village evening lantern parade, princess friends star paper lantern central, real stars overhead.

notes: Original story and illustrations; all family profiles can read it.
